tasks.answer: FlightDelayCompensationBatchScreen is the batch compensation workspace covering standard, special and review steps; it requires batchId.
The only traveler booking list screen in the catalog is TravelerBookingListScreen: a paginated booking list with search and filters; navigate is required (initialStatus optional).
PasswordInput is a password field with show/hide labels. It must be used inside UiFormField; the error is a string passed to and displayed by the form-field wrapper.

The booking list uses business.SearchBar (required: value, placeholder, onChange) and business.FilterSheet (required: visible, title, children, onClose); both import from @/components/business/mobile.

AuthRecoveryDialog is the global auth-recovery dialog: mount it once near the app root (production example src/App.tsx). It subscribes to the auth recovery store and renders null while no recovery event is pending. AuthRecoveryDialogView is its internal view, not the global mount.

notes: Five searches (one per task, using importPath/requiredProps/summary where sufficient) plus one batched get for the three detail-needing IDs (tasks 2, 3, 5), so no ID was repeated and each task stayed within one get. Only the 2.9 KB catalog config was opened; no project source files and no component-catalog.json were read or modified.
